set.body:
Outcome

Make the known RowPos versus SampleId defect executable before redesign.

Acceptance

- Uses semantic sample IDs that differ from physical ordinals.
- Demonstrates current dense and operator restrictions disagree before the fix.
- Covers restriction, reordering, stacking, targets, metadata, and fold selections.
- Becomes a shared JVM and Scala.js acceptance court for the new axis model.
set.title: P0.3: add the noncanonical sample-identity regression court
